why.drive-dc-motor: One direction only; speed by PWM.

why.switch-high-current: Seven sink channels, up to 500 mA each.

why.regulate-5v: Adjustable: set its output to 5 V.

why.absorb-flyback: Fine for small relays; use a 1N4007 for motors.

why.amplify-signal: A Darlington pair: very high gain.

why.detect-obstacle: Only once the robot touches it.
Only at very short range (a few mm to ~2 cm).

why.measure-temperature: Mainly a pressure sensor; it also reads temperature.

measure-distance.label: Measure distance
measure-distance.why: Reports how far the nearest object is.

detect-obstacle.label: Detect obstacles
detect-obstacle.why: Tells your robot something is in its way.

detect-collision.label: Detect collisions
detect-collision.why: Closes a contact when the robot touches something.

follow-line.label: Follow a line
follow-line.why: Sees a dark line on a light floor so the robot can track it.

measure-humidity.label: Measure humidity
measure-humidity.why: Reads the relative humidity of the air.

measure-pressure.label: Measure air pressure
measure-pressure.why: Reads air pressure, which also gives altitude.

measure-soil-moisture.label: Measure soil moisture
measure-soil-moisture.why: Tells how wet the soil is, for plant projects.

sense-light.label: Sense light
sense-light.why: Its reading changes with how bright it is.

detect-motion.label: Detect motion
detect-motion.why: Notices a person or animal moving nearby.

detect-sound.label: Detect sound
detect-sound.why: Reacts to loud sounds such as a clap.

measure-tilt.label: Measure tilt
measure-tilt.why: Tells which way the part is leaning.

measure-acceleration.label: Measure acceleration
measure-acceleration.why: Measures speeding up, shaking and gravity.

measure-rotation.label: Measure rotation
measure-rotation.why: Tells how far or how fast something turns.

user-input-button.label: Button input
user-input-button.why: The user presses it to give a command.

user-input-knob.label: Knob input
user-input-knob.why: The user turns it to set a value.

user-input-joystick.label: Joystick input
user-input-joystick.why: Two-axis stick for steering or games.

user-input-keypad.label: Keypad input
user-input-keypad.why: Lets the user type digits and codes.

drive-dc-motor.label: Drive a DC motor
drive-dc-motor.why: Lets a pin control a motor’s speed and direction.

drive-two-dc-motors.label: Drive two motors
drive-two-dc-motors.why: Has two channels: one per wheel.

drive-stepper.label: Drive a stepper
drive-stepper.why: Powers the coils of a stepper motor in order.

spin-wheel.label: Spin a wheel
spin-wheel.why: A geared motor that turns a robot wheel.

move-to-angle.label: Move to an angle
move-to-angle.why: Turns to the angle your code asks for and holds it.

rotate-in-steps.label: Rotate in steps
rotate-in-steps.why: Turns in exact steps for precise positions.

show-number.label: Show numbers
show-number.why: Displays digits such as a count or a reading.

show-graphics.label: Show graphics
show-graphics.why: Draws pixels, shapes and simple graphs.

show-status-light.label: Status light
show-status-light.why: Lights up to show a state.

show-colors.label: Show colours
show-colors.why: Mixes red, green and blue into any colour.

light-strip.label: LED strip
light-strip.why: Many LEDs, each set separately from one pin.

play-tone.label: Play tones
play-tone.why: Plays the note frequency your code chooses.

switch-high-current.label: Switch a big load
switch-high-current.why: Lets a pin turn on loads that need more current than a pin can give.

switch-small-load.label: Switch a small load
switch-small-load.why: A transistor switch for LEDs, buzzers and small relays.

isolate-load.label: Isolate a load
isolate-load.why: Switches a separate circuit with no electrical link to the board.

amplify-signal.label: Amplify
amplify-signal.why: A small current controls a much larger one.

regulate-5v.label: Make 5 V
regulate-5v.why: Gives a steady 5 V from a higher supply.

regulate-3v3.label: Make 3.3 V
regulate-3v3.why: Gives a steady 3.3 V for 3.3 V parts.

step-down-voltage.label: Lower a voltage
step-down-voltage.why: Turns a higher supply into a lower, steady one.

supply-battery-power.label: Battery power
supply-battery-power.why: Powers the circuit without a cable.

switch-power.label: Power switch
switch-power.why: Turns the whole circuit on and off.

store-energy.label: Store energy
store-energy.why: Holds charge and releases it later.

smooth-voltage.label: Smooth a supply
smooth-voltage.why: Absorbs dips and noise on a supply line.

limit-current.label: Limit current
limit-current.why: Keeps the current low enough to be safe, e.g. for an LED.

divide-voltage.label: Divide a voltage
divide-voltage.why: Makes a fraction of a voltage, e.g. to read it on an analog pin.

pull-up-input.label: Pull-up / pull-down
pull-up-input.why: Gives an input a known level when nothing drives it.

block-reverse-current.label: Block reverse current
block-reverse-current.why: Lets current flow one way only.

absorb-flyback.label: Flyback protection
absorb-flyback.why: Absorbs the voltage spike when a coil or motor switches off.

clamp-voltage.label: Clamp a voltage
clamp-voltage.why: Stops a voltage from rising above its rating.

logic-gate.label: Logic gates
logic-gate.why: Combines digital signals with AND, OR, NOT or XOR.

clean-up-signal.label: Clean up a signal
clean-up-signal.why: Turns a slow or noisy edge into a sharp one.

count-pulses.label: Count pulses
count-pulses.why: Steps through its outputs on each pulse.

generate-pulses.label: Generate pulses
generate-pulses.why: Makes a steady on/off signal without any code.

build-robot-base.label: Robot base
build-robot-base.why: The frame that carries the board, motors and sensors.
